methodology: Long-horizon suite A: early authoritative FACT planted at turn 1; each later turn appends large obsolete tool noise (and competing pseudo-FACTs). Soft-invalidation markers are harness-applied on obsolete spans for DynCLM/immediate (CLM) arms; the cost-model scheduler fires batched rewrites. Periodic probes ask for the early FACT. Metrics per turn: context length, prompt/generated tokens, wall-clock, gen tokens/s. Early vs late windows express the paper claim that smaller context improves late-session quality and generation performance vs raw append-only.
